name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 11 – Am 8
title: REPORT on a revamped long-term budget for the Union in a changing world
part_text: 11a. Opposes the adoption of new own resources, given that the purchasing power of Union citizens is already in a critical situation; calls for better management of EU funds and genuine budgetary control in order to create substantial fiscal room for manoeuvre, including through the implementation of the numerous recommendations made by the European Court of Auditors;
